input: ordinary Latin and vernacular medical source repertoire
operation: Keep ordinary source language outside the card layer
hard_rule: No Voynich surface is assigned a sound
failure_if_violated: A historical source language would be falsely deciphered

operation: Copy the eleven exact whole-card mnemonics as indivisible entries
hard_rule: Mnemonic labels remain exploratory concepts, never phonetic expansions
failure_if_violated: A short card becomes a sentence or a guessed wordform

operation: Copy the four formal prompts as slots, not words
hard_rule: Formal prompts have no lexical meaning
failure_if_violated: Control syntax is confused with prose

operation: Prepare one template sheet per register
hard_rule: A template licenses order only, never a concrete noun
failure_if_violated: Plant, patient, vessel, body part or star is smuggled into a card

operation: Reserve an exemplar-tail column copied as opaque whole cards
hard_rule: No tail item is generalized by substring
failure_if_violated: An unlicensed dictionary grows from local accident

operation: Record wrapper, allograph, field-break and closure conventions
hard_rule: Graphic variation may not change licensed identity
failure_if_violated: A hand variant is treated as a new meaning

operation: Normalize source clauses and lookup inventories without recoding them
hard_rule: Preserve source order and uncertainty
failure_if_violated: Later cards inherit invented prose

operation: Apply ellipsis, anonymous registers and the common deck
hard_rule: Only licensed exact cards are substituted
failure_if_violated: The copy cannot be checked against a stable exemplar

operation: Make register-specific copies C-Herbal, C-Bio and C-Astro
hard_rule: Copy local tails exactly and proof against E2
failure_if_violated: Independent semantic improvisation destroys genealogy

operation: Choose register and declare record boundary
hard_rule: OWNER ACTIVE TARGET PREVIOUS reset at every record
failure_if_violated: Carries leak between unrelated pictures

operation: Bind a silent OWNER only when the image or local exemplar supports it
hard_rule: OWNER remains anonymous in the card layer
failure_if_violated: A pictured plant or woman becomes a card gloss

operation: Put content into the register order specified by M13-M15
hard_rule: Physical manuscript line is not a sentence
failure_if_violated: Reflow is mistaken for syntax

operation: Order owner or rubric, part and measure, preparation and medium, state, application, then storage or variant
hard_rule: All plant, medium, ailment and body-site nouns stay IMAGE GENRE or EXEMPLAR
failure_if_violated: Open prose is falsely compressed into the small deck

operation: Order station or owner, active charge, amount, relation or target, state or action, drain or close, then parallel cell
hard_rule: Body, bath, patient, vessel and conduit remain IMAGE or EXEMPLAR
failure_if_violated: Apparatus-shaped cells are overmedicalized

operation: Order external choice, spatial address, local label or rule, then act or defer outside the card reading
hard_rule: Every planet, sign, mansion, body sector and rule name is LOCAL_EXEMPLAR
failure_if_violated: A diagram label becomes a decoded word

operation: Omit repeated owner or object and update ACTIVE TARGET PREVIOUS
hard_rule: Carries are record-local and explicitly stateful
failure_if_violated: Silent arguments become portable card meanings

operation: Replace only exact licensed occurrences with common-deck cards
hard_rule: No decomposition, substring semantics or phonetic mapping
failure_if_violated: Brevigraphy becomes a speculative cipher alphabet

operation: Insert formal prompts for opaque slots
hard_rule: A formal prompt cannot supply a German word
failure_if_violated: Slot and lexical content collapse

operation: Copy unknown exemplar-tail cards whole and in order
hard_rule: Unknown means exemplar-dependent, not empty
failure_if_violated: Rare semantic content is invented during expansion

operation: Place packet in picture cell or diagram locus and reflow across physical lines
hard_rule: Line breaking must not change source clause state
failure_if_violated: Line ends are falsely read as full stops

operation: Read and recopy Recipe, ana, fiat, take, stamp, temper and apply formulae
hard_rule: This stage precedes the private deck
failure_if_violated: A learner knows signs but not the technical task

operation: Drill contraction, suspension, superscript and special-sign recognition
hard_rule: Conventional abbreviation is distinct from the private whole-card deck
failure_if_violated: Every abbreviation is treated as a secret sign

operation: Memorize by exact-card flash table and bidirectional copying
hard_rule: Only fifteen common entries are learned semantically
failure_if_violated: Local tails are overgeneralized

operation: Compile and back-expand sample Herbal, Bio and Astro packets
hard_rule: Back-expansion must mark all silent additions
failure_if_violated: The apprentice mistakes editorial completion for card value

operation: Copy one complete record of each register and proof it
hard_rule: Estimated six to twelve weeks for an already literate assistant; semantic independence is not achieved
failure_if_violated: Duration is mistaken for manuscript evidence

operation: Transfer at a record boundary and reset all four registers
hard_rule: Prefer record-boundary handoff
failure_if_violated: A new hand inherits the wrong active item

operation: Write or orally declare OWNER ACTIVE TARGET PREVIOUS plus current template and tail position
hard_rule: No unstated cross-record carry
failure_if_violated: Continuation cannot be reproduced

operation: Repeat a catchword or edge card and verify it as one clause
hard_rule: A repeated edge card is not assigned a second meaning
failure_if_violated: The f82r edge copy becomes two instructions

operation: Back-read cards to mnemonic or slot labels and point every silent noun to image, genre or exemplar
hard_rule: Unknown tails are checked graphically, not guessed
failure_if_violated: The copy looks fluent only because the reader invents content

operation: Reject unauthorized new common cards; amend only E2 and codebook together
hard_rule: No copyist may coin a meaning locally
failure_if_violated: Multi-scribe transmission forks the codebook
